verdict.rationale: Docs show tools can call any API including refund/order/subscription-type endpoints (Stripe, internal APIs), with per-tool guardrails like requiring Slack approval above a dollar threshold, auto-approve toggles per task, and role-based access controls, matching the scoped, action-level authorization pattern described. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of scoped auth enforcement, explicit per-action API key/permission scoping documentation beyond approval gating.
